metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows three methods that can instantly relieve a stuffy nose.

These easy exercises will focus on covering all bases. This includes helping to clear up sinus and nasal congestion, and improving lymph flow to flush out bad bacteria and mucus (helpful for allergies, colds, and flu). 

All of the exercises can be done at home, require no equipment, and may give stuffy nose relief within seconds.

Let us know how the exercises work for you!
